messages:
zoe: Heads-up: 20m pre-QBR triage for LatticeWorks today 2pm PT. Focus: token econ (embeddings-heavy), 90d spend forecast, renewal risk. Can 2pm attendees join? cc @rahul @kt

rahul: I can join. Need per-route token export and the recent change note (switched to 512-d embeddings last week).

kt: Got it. I'll pull the per-route CSV and the onboarding checklist. Theres an open action on prefix caching thats inflating spend.

fin-bot: Billing alert: LatticeWorks embed usage +78% day-over-day. Invoice flag B-9123.

zoe: Agenda: 1) run-rate + two scenarios (x1.25, x2) 2) quick mitigations (batching, cache, quotas) 3) owner list for enablement fixes.

rahul: Quick numbers (rough): current run-rate $6.4k/mo; x1.25 -> $8k/mo; x2 -> $12.8k/mo. Assumes 2 vectors/request @512-d. Will post CSV before sync.

kt: Enablement snippet for caching (pseudo):
```
if prefix in cache:
  return cache[prefix]
else:
  v = embed(prefix)
  cache[prefix] = v
  return v
```
I'll demo in the triage.

support-bot: Note: customer reported slow retries causing duplicate embeddings. See ticket #4321.

zoe: Locking 2pm. Rahul/KT please drop the CSV and the short reserve vs throttle note in this thread before the QBR. I'll send pre-read to the customer. :thumbsup:
